purpose: Reachable verified-data benchmark while the strict full-market PIT lane is blocked.

includeOnly: frozen market, symbol, feature and label identities
exclude: forced fallback probabilities or forced positive ranks
dataPolicy.missingFundamentals: Omit unavailable columns; never encode missing verified fundamentals as observed zero.

nonPromotionRules: Research thresholds are not production thresholds.
Research cannot activate longTradeGate or overwrite a Champion.
Each comparable experiment requires one changed hypothesis and a new lockbox.
Unresolved PIT ambiguity is NO_MODEL, not a degraded model.
reentryConditions: At least one new real ASX official PDF is accepted and written to strict PIT datasets.
Gate03 is rerun with updated evidence and permits the strict lane.
Strict calibration, Top-K, cost-after-EV and rolling stability gates pass on untouched evidence.
